company.name: GALVANY
company.tagline: Building the OS for a carbon-neutral future.
company.description:
GALVANY is a Green-Tech company creating the central platform for the heat transition. By bringing together cutting-edge hardware and intelligent software, we simplify the most complex parts of the energy journey: planning, subsidies, and installation management.
We don't compete with the trade; we empower it. Our end-to-end infrastructure allows for faster, more predictable workflows, helping installers scale and giving homeowners access to smart energy systems-even without their own PV. We are the digital engine driving a mass-market energy transition.
